newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Tess to contest Brazil B Band disqualification.
newsitem.headline: Tess to contest Brazil B Band disqualification.

text.p: The Tess consortia, comprised of Airline cellular of Brazil and Swedish telecom operator Telia will challenge its disqualification in Brazil's cellular Band B bidding, a group representive said.
Newton Scartezini said the consortium, which also includes local firm Primave, part of Brazilian construction group C.R. Alameida, disagreed with the ministry's reason for disqualifying it.
"Challenging this is exactly what we're going to do," Scartezini told reporters. Tess had presented bids for areas 1-6, 9 and 10.

The Communications Ministry rejected Tess' bids for B band concessions because it said it did not present the name of its legal representative in Brazil and did not use an official translator to provide a document in Portuguese.
Scartezini said that the group had believed it did not have to present a legal representative, but simply had to have one in Brazil, which it does.
Secondly, he said the document in question had not been traslated because it was originally written in Portuguese.
Groups that failed to bid have five working days to appeal.
